rationale: End-2024 register of ~6.8 million cars (Vietnam Register) plus 2025 net additions; NSO publishes cars and motorbikes only as one combined total by province
~3.45 million of ~6.8 million registered cars had 9 seats or fewer at end-2024; the remainder are trucks, buses, pickups and special vehicles
Allocation of cars across provinces: car share of the provincial fleet scales with (GRDP per capita)^elasticity; range covers published income elasticities of car ownership in developing economies
Share of the commercial-vehicle allocation driven by road freight tonnage (rest follows the car allocation)
Forecast: motorbikes per capita respond weakly to income because ownership is near saturation (~780 motorbikes per 1000 people in 2025)
Forecast: commercial-vehicle fleet growth relative to road freight tonnage growth
Forecast: cars per capita growth relative to real GRDP per capita growth
